svg.title: The observed event mean is unusual in placebo windows
svg.desc: Distribution of 10,000 within-country placebo means for the twelve-month change in log exports divided by imports. The actual nine-event mean is 10.58 log points, compared with a placebo mean of minus 1.36 and a placebo 95th percentile of 5.23. The one-sided randomization p-value is 0.0018. All draws, including the tails, are shown. The comparison demonstrates that the observed event mean is unusual relative to the chosen placebo windows; it does not make devaluation timing exogenous.
